title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Membership Periods Schedule
content:
The periods that govern a Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership's standing are fixed per tier: the days allowed after enrollment to complete business verification, the months without a qualifying purchase after which the membership is closed, whether the membership is suspended when the member's Ridgeline Pro Credit account is charged off, and the months after a suspension before the membership is reviewed for reinstatement.

| Tier | Days after enrollment within which business verification must be completed | Months without a qualifying purchase after which the membership is closed | Suspended when the member's Ridgeline Pro Credit account is charged off | Months after suspension before review for reinstatement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Member | 10 | 24 | Yes | 12 |
| ProBuild Bronze | 10 | 24 | Yes | 12 |
| ProBuild Silver | 10 | 24 | Yes | 12 |
| ProBuild Gold | 10 | 36 | Yes | 6 |
| ProBuild Platinum | 10 | 36 | Yes | 6 |
| ProBuild Platinum Elite | 10 | 36 | Yes | 6 |

## Points of reading

- The verification period is 10 calendar days at every tier.
- The inactivity period is 24 months at ProBuild Member, ProBuild Bronze and ProBuild Silver, and 36 months from ProBuild Gold upward.
- A charge-off of the member's Ridgeline Pro Credit account leads to suspension at every tier.
- The review after a suspension comes 12 months after it at the three lowest tiers and 6 months after it from ProBuild Gold upward.
